name: Administrator-only course management

description:
Students may receive a video link only when authenticated, paid and enrolled
  in the video's course. Administrators may preview videos without enrollment.

elements.name: A guest cannot obtain a video link

steps.name: an isolated tutorial platform with an existing course and video
I am a "guest"
I request the course video
the response status should be 401
the response error should be "Missing or invalid authorization header"
the private video link should not be disclosed

elements.name: An invalid identity cannot obtain a video link

steps.name: an isolated tutorial platform with an existing course and video
I am an "invalid identity"
I request the course video
the response status should be 401
the response error should be "Unauthorized: Invalid token"
the private video link should not be disclosed

elements.name: A paid enrolled student can access the video

steps.name: an isolated tutorial platform with an existing course and video
I am a "student"
my payment status is "paid"
I am enrolled in the video's course
I request the course video
the response status should be 200
I should receive only the permitted video details

elements.name: An unpaid student is denied even when enrollment is present

steps.name: an isolated tutorial platform with an existing course and video
I am a "student"
my payment status is "unpaid"
my enrollment in the video's course is "present"
I request the course video
the response status should be 403
the response error should be "Forbidden: User has not paid"
the private video link should not be disclosed

elements.name: An unpaid student is denied even when enrollment is absent

steps.name: an isolated tutorial platform with an existing course and video
I am a "student"
my payment status is "unpaid"
my enrollment in the video's course is "absent"
I request the course video
the response status should be 403
the response error should be "Forbidden: User has not paid"
the private video link should not be disclosed

elements.name: Payment alone does not grant course access

steps.name: an isolated tutorial platform with an existing course and video
I am a "student"
my payment status is "paid"
my enrollment in the video's course is "absent"
I request the course video
the response status should be 403
the response error should be "Forbidden: Not enrolled in this course"
the private video link should not be disclosed

elements.name: An enrollment for another course does not grant this access

steps.name: an isolated tutorial platform with an existing course and video
I am a "student"
my payment status is "paid"
the only enrollment belongs to "another course"
I request the course video
the response status should be 403
the response error should be "Forbidden: Not enrolled in this course"
the private video link should not be disclosed

elements.name: An enrollment for another student does not grant this access

steps.name: an isolated tutorial platform with an existing course and video
I am a "student"
my payment status is "paid"
the only enrollment belongs to "another student"
I request the course video
the response status should be 403
the response error should be "Forbidden: Not enrolled in this course"
the private video link should not be disclosed

elements.name: An administrator may preview without payment or enrollment

steps.name: an isolated tutorial platform with an existing course and video
I am an "admin"
my payment status is "unpaid"
my enrollment in the video's course is "absent"
I request the course video
the response status should be 200
I should receive only the permitted video details

elements.name: A paid student receives a clear error for a missing video

steps.name: an isolated tutorial platform with an existing course and video
I am a "student"
my payment status is "paid"
I am enrolled in the video's course
I request a video that does not exist
the response status should be 404
the response error should be "Video not found"
the private video link should not be disclosed
